changeSet.author: tklok
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[AssetTag_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[AssetTag] AFTER DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID],[AssetID]) SELECT 'ObjectIndex', 'U', A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.ID FROM deleted D INNER JOIN [dbo].[Asset] A ON D.AssetID = A.ID WHERE A.[Object] not in('FusionAttribute', 'FusionQueryAttribute'); GO
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[AssetTag_AfterUpsert] ON [dbo].[AssetTag] AFTER INSERT, UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID],[AssetID]) SELECT 'ObjectIndex', 'U', A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.ID FROM inserted I INNER JOIN [dbo].[Asset] A ON I.AssetID = A.ID WHERE A.[Object] not in('FusionAttribute', 'FusionQueryAttribute'); GO
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[Tag_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[Tag] AFTER UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID],[AssetID]) SELECT 'ObjectIndex', 'U', A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.ID FROM inserted I INNER JOIN [dbo].[AssetTag] T ON I.ID = T.TagID INNER JOIN [dbo].[Asset] A ON T.AssetID = A.ID WHERE A.[Object] not in('FusionAttribute', 'FusionQueryAttribute'); GO
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[AssetTag_AfterDelete] GO DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[AssetTag_AfterUpsert] GO DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[Tag_AfterUpdate] GO
